title: AI game jam with $7K in prizes — starts this weekend
author: Sol_is_Playful
selftext:
I'm helping throw Playful.ai's first[ Game Jam— an AI game jam with $7K in prizes.](https://itch.io/jam/playfulai-jam-1) Our studio is brand new and the game jam is small...but that's because we're flying on the radar for a bit and just coming out of stealth. Our founders (and jam judges) include [the guy who made Farmville, and the guy who ran AI gaming at Netflix](https://www.pocketgamer.biz/mike-verdu-and-mark-pincus-form-ai-startup-playfulai/), so getting noticed could be a game changer.

This jam is all about merge games AKA games built with combination mechanics—where players mix elements, objects, or concepts to discover new ones, creating endless discovery loops that keep people hooked.

Basically there's seven days to build something that starts simple but explodes into infinite possibilities. ⚡️

The game jam kicks off this weekend, so make sure to [sign up now](https://itch.io/jam/playfulai-jam-1)!

comments.author: blackwidowink
comments.body: Can you expand further on I what this core requirement means: 🤖 At least one AI enhanced element or mechanic?

replies.author: Sol_is_Playful
replies.body: Absolutely! Basically, you can use AI to power the engine/code, Gen AI, or honestly... any kind of AI. We're deliberately being loose about the \*type\* of AI you can use for this one! Classic AI (or whatever we call non-gen-AI) is allowed (though considering the reddit this convo is in, I assume folks here are into testing things with GenAI!)
